name: eligible_free_rate_ages_5_17

name: charter_school
explanation: Business rule 'charter school': frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 (the authoritative charter flag); "directly charter-funded" = frpm.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'

name: exclusively_virtual_school
search_text: exclusively virtual school definition business rule
explanation: Business rule 'exclusively virtual school': schools.Virtual = 'F' ('P' = partially virtual, 'N' = not virtual)

name: magnet_school_offers_a_magnet_program
search_text: magnet school / offers a magnet program definition business rule
explanation: Business rule 'magnet school / offers a magnet program': schools.Magnet = 1

name: active_open_currently_operating_school
search_text: active / open / currently operating school definition business rule
explanation: Business rule 'active / open / currently operating school': schools.StatusType = 'Active'; school-level rows only (schools.School IS NOT NULL; rows with NULL School are district or county office entries)

name: sat_excellence_rate
search_text: SAT excellence rate definition business rule
explanation: Business rule 'SAT excellence rate': satscores.NumGE1500 / satscores.NumTstTakr (cast to REAL)

name: school_level_sat_records
search_text: school-level SAT records definition business rule
explanation: Business rule 'school-level SAT records': satscores.rtype = 'S'; rtype = 'D' rows are district aggregates and must be excluded when ranking or counting schools

name: high_poverty_school
explanation: Business rule 'high-poverty school': frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.75 (the column is a fraction 0-1)

name: sat_total_score
search_text: SAT total score definition business rule
explanation: Business rule 'SAT total score': AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite

name: large_bank_failure
explanation: Business rule 'large bank (failure)': bank_failures."Assets ($mil.)" >= 10000, i.e. assets of at least $10 billion

name: financial_crisis_period
search_text: financial crisis period definition business rule
explanation: Business rule 'financial crisis period': failure Date from 2008-01-01 to 2011-12-31 inclusive; "after the crisis" = Date > 2011-12-31

name: paid_off_directly_no_acquirer
search_text: paid off directly / no acquirer definition business rule
explanation: Business rule 'paid off directly / no acquirer': bank_failures."Acquired by" = 'None (insured depositors paid directly)'
